name: @red-cup-engineering/app-discord-steward
description: The parameterized, runnable form of @emsenn/organizing-with-discord: give it a server name, bot name, bot key, and admin username, and it runs an autonomous steward in that Discord server while measuring and de-enclosing the server within the section 12 automate/keep-human boundary.

scripts.check: npm run build:deps && npm run check:local
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run build:local
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
